items.title: Sigma Expands Rolls-Royce Partnership with £125 Million Additional Long-term Agreement Following its Strategic Bromford Acquisition - Raksha Anirveda
items.summary: Sigma has expanded its long-term partnership with Rolls-Royce through a £125 million additional agreement following its Bromford acquisition, signaling increased revenue potential and deepened commercial ties for RR.

items.title: BHP Group (ASX:BHP): Copper Growth Strategy Takes Centre Stage Under New CEO Brandon Craig - Kalkine
items.summary: BHP's new CEO Brandon Craig is prioritizing copper growth, which matters because copper demand is surging from electric vehicles and renewable energy, positioning BHP to capitalize on a multi-decade structural tailwind.
